claims.statement: X documents an OAuth 2.0 user access token created through the Authorization Code Flow with PKCE, used as a Bearer token in place of the app-only Bearer Token.

sources.supports: Instead of passing your Bearer Token, you
the access token you create through the Authorization Code Flow with PKCE will only stay valid for two hours
sources.locator: How long will my credentials stay valid?

claims.statement: X states OAuth 2.0 access tokens expire after 2 hours.

sources.supports: OAuth 2.0 access tokens expire after **2 hours**.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Format of the OAuth 2.0 user access token is not stated on the pages read.
The pages show example tokens in the same Authorization: Bearer header as the app-only Bearer Token; whether the two are distinguishable by shape is unresolved and no shape is recorded.
The candidate is established to exist from the pages read; its format (prefix, alphabet, length) is not researched.
